overview.pattern: Single-process multi-chain event-driven trading bot with embedded API/dashboard
overview.description: src/bot.ts startMultiChainBot builds per-chain contexts (src/chainRegistry.ts), listens for new DEX V2 pairs / V3 pools and Telegram alpha calls, runs safety checks, buys, then manages exits and anti-rug monitoring; Express API + WebSocket (src/api/server.ts) serves the React dashboard (dashboard/).

data-flow.flow: DEX factory events / Telegram (src/telegramListener.ts -> src/alphaDrop.ts) -> handleNewPairForChain (src/bot.ts) -> tokenSafety + honeypot simulation -> riskManager.canSnipe -> txManager/MEV strategy buy -> db.insertTrade -> exitEngine + anti-rug detector -> sell
data-flow.description: State persisted in SQLite (src/utils/db.ts); alerts via src/utils/notifier.ts and WS broadcast.

component:ChainRegistry.responsibility: Per-chain context (providers, DEX V2/V3 allowlists, config)

component:SafetyPipeline.responsibility: Honeypot/roundtrip simulation, external providers (GoPlus, honeypot.is, Mudra, Unicrypt), blocklist, LP lock and limits checks

component:RiskManager.responsibility: Exposure, position count, daily loss gating (canSnipe)

component:MevSubmission.responsibility: Private submission (Flashbots, bloXroute) with inclusion reconciliation and public fallback; nonce serialization in src/utils/nonceAuthority.ts

component:ExitEngine.responsibility: Stop-loss, take-profit tiers, trailing, timed sells; per-token sell locks; serialized exit state

component:AntiRug.responsibility: LP burn/removal detection, LP baseline, exit trigger, per-chain circuit breaker, race telemetry

component:API.responsibility: Express 5 routes with session auth middleware, helmet, WS broadcaster; serves dashboard/dist SPA

component:Preflight.responsibility: Read-only cold-start checks: RPC chainId/block age, balances, gas affordability, MEV health, checker bytecode

security.keys: Wallet from env via src/utils/provider.ts getWallet

testing.framework: Vitest unit/integration/fork projects (vitest.config.ts); Hardhat for contracts (hardhat.config.ts)

conventions.file-organization: src/ top-level domain modules, src/utils/ infrastructure, src/anti-rug/ and src/api/ subsystems
conventions.imports: relative TS imports, CommonJS output via tsc
